name: RoboSats
description: RoboSats is a simple and private peer-to-peer Bitcoin exchange client. It serves the local web app and can proxy coordinator API traffic through a Tor SOCKS proxy, using Lightning hold invoices to reduce custody and trust requirements.

paths.name: Install Path
paths.description: Host path used as the Unraid install/appdata location for this RoboSats container.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: RoboSats self-hosted client web interface. Container port: 12596.

variables.name: Tor Proxy IP
variables.description: Optional SOCKS Tor proxy host used by the client to reach coordinators. Use a reachable Tor container hostname, IP, or host proxy address. Leave blank only for local UI use without coordinator connectivity or when overriding the image runtime.

variables.name: Tor Proxy Port
variables.description: Optional SOCKS Tor proxy port used by the client to reach coordinators, commonly 9050. Leave blank only with the same caveats as Tor Proxy IP.
